regulator: Mississippi Secretary of State, Securities Division
reason: The Secretary of State enforcement search is public and can be filtered toward securities. The first result page is not a census, and the on-screen total was not captured as a securities-only order count. Individual orders were not downloaded and were not attached to CRDs. A cease-and-desist is not a final adjudication. A complaint form is intake, not a finding. Missing rows are not zero orders.
